title: SFFS Rebus Carousel
description: Contract for one rebus word-picture carousel post. Mirrors the live RebusCarouselProps in remotion/hermes/RebusCarousel.tsx (props) wrapped in a post envelope (slug/title/caption/hashtagSet). Rendered by tools/render-carousel.ts to renders.nosync/carousels/<slug>/. We never say "rebus" on-screen. See content/carousels/ and CONTENT_PIPELINE.md.

sourceIds.description: IDs from content/rebus-bank.json this post draws from (provenance).

hashtagSet.description: Which set in content/carousel-posting.json to use (A|B|C|D).

prompt.description: Instruction on each puzzle slide (never says "rebus").

topic.description: Category pill, top-left of each puzzle slide (e.g. BRAIN TEASER).

outroCta.description: Outro CTA pill (e.g. FOLLOW FOR MORE).

field.description: Post-level puzzle-field color; omitted = rotate per slide.

rows.description: Stacked text rows. Omitted when answerOnly, or use `filled` instead.

filled.description: Big outlined word tiled with a filler word. Takes precedence over rows.

answer.description: The solved phrase (UPPERCASE on the reveal card).

explanation.description: How the picture encodes the answer. Empty string = no explanation card.

reveal.description: true = this puzzle gets an answer slide; false = comment-bait.

answerOnly.description: true = answer slide ONLY (no puzzle slide) and excluded from PUZZLE N OF M numbering.

field.description: Per-puzzle field color override; beats the post-level field + rotation.

size.description: big (default) for main words, small for helpers.

ruled.description: Draw horizontal rules above/below (e.g. reading BETWEEN lines).

color.description: Ink the row a brand color (e.g. green for GREEN with envy).

ghost.description: Transparent leading text reserving space to show a MISSING letter (e.g. ghost C for ENTURY).

filler.description: The word tiled inside its glyphs (e.g. BOLOGNA).
